verdict.rationale: monday.com gives each agent its own identity and lets admins scope each agent's board access. Its app framework also supports granular scopes such as `boards:read`. Together these are a first-party least-privilege mechanism for agents, but the evidence is marketing-level and never explicitly describes issuing a scoped API token or key to an agent. missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing per-agent scoped API credentials/tokens, the full scope catalog and its granularity beyond board access, credential rotation/revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Each agent gets its own identity on monday.
Request granular scopes like `boards:read`. Store keys in managed secret storage.
Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes
